sql: WITH captured AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM payments p WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' ), returned AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM refunds r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' ) SELECT captured.amount - returned.amount AS net_receipts_cents FROM captured CROSS JOIN returned

WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), returned AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), cities AS ( SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) - COALESCE(returned.amount, 0) AS net_receipts_cents FROM cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.city = cities.city

WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), returned AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), cities AS ( SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) - COALESCE(returned.amount, 0) AS net_receipts_cents FROM cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.city = cities.city WHERE cities.city IN ('上海', '北京')

WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), returned AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), cities AS ( SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) - COALESCE(returned.amount, 0) AS net_receipts_cents FROM cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.city = cities.city WHERE cities.city IN ('上海', '北京')

WITH by_city AS ( SELECT c.city, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS refunded_cents FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ) SELECT city, refunded_cents FROM by_city ORDER BY refunded_cents DESC, city ASC LIMIT 1

WITH october AS ( SELECT c.city, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS refunded_cents FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), september AS ( SELECT c.city, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS refunded_cents FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), top_city AS ( SELECT city FROM october ORDER BY refunded_cents DESC, city ASC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT '2026-09' AS month, september.city, september.refunded_cents FROM september WHERE september.city = (SELECT city FROM top_city) UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10' AS month, october.city, october.refunded_cents FROM october WHERE october.city = (SELECT city FROM top_city)

WITH top5 AS ( SELECT p.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE p.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top5)

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT c.category_name AS category_name, substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents) AS merchandise_cents FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.category_name, substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7) ), top2 AS ( SELECT category_name FROM monthly WHERE month = '2026-10' ORDER BY merchandise_cents DESC, category_name ASC LIMIT 2 ) SELECT month, category_name, merchandise_cents FROM monthly WHERE category_name IN (SELECT category_name FROM top2)

WITH partial_orders AS ( SELECT p.order_id FROM payments p JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY p.order_id HAVING SUM(r.amount_cents) > 0 AND SUM(r.amount_cents) < ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2.amount_cents), 0) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.order_id = p.order_id AND p2.status = 'succeeded' ) ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS partial_refund_order_count FROM partial_orders

WITH partial_orders AS ( SELECT p.order_id FROM payments p JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY p.order_id HAVING SUM(r.amount_cents) > 0 AND SUM(r.amount_cents) < ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2.amount_cents), 0) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.order_id = p.order_id AND p2.status = 'succeeded' ) ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS refunded_cents FROM partial_orders po JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = po.order_id AND p.status = 'succeeded' JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed'

WITH partial_orders AS ( SELECT p.order_id FROM payments p JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY p.order_id HAVING SUM(r.amount_cents) > 0 AND SUM(r.amount_cents) < ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2.amount_cents), 0) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.order_id = p.order_id AND p2.status = 'succeeded' ) ) SELECT c.city, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS refunded_cents FROM partial_orders po JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = po.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = po.order_id AND p.status = 'succeeded' JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.city

WITH captured AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM payments p WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' ), returned AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM refunds r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' ) SELECT captured.amount - returned.amount AS net_receipts_cents FROM captured CROSS JOIN returned

WITH captured AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM payments p WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' ), returned AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM refunds r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' ) SELECT captured.amount - returned.amount AS net_receipts_cents FROM captured CROSS JOIN returned

SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z')) - ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')) AS growth_cents

SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z')) - ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'))) * 1.0 / ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')) END AS growth_rate

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents), 0) AS merchandise_cents FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '数码'

SELECT substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7) AS ordered_month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents) AS merchandise_cents FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '数码' GROUP BY substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7)

WITH months(month, start_at, end_at) AS ( SELECT '2026-09', '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10', '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' ) SELECT m.month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.category_name = '数码' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents END), 0) AS merchandise_cents FROM months m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.ordered_at >= m.start_at AND o.ordered_at < m.end_at LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY m.month

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.full_name FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY refunded_cents DESC, c.full_name ASC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY refunded_cents DESC, c.full_name ASC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refunded_cents), 0) AS top5_refunded_cents FROM ranked

WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) AS captured_cents FROM (SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers) AS cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city
